decisions.reason: Locates inject/apiProxy.llm.providers/package.json pin; maps to DSH-0.1.2-A1-01 with grounded reasoning (not a bare card name); explains host-plane inject ['llm'] + ctx.llm.listProviders(), warns against the remote swap, and prescribes removing the dead dsh-host-apiproxy dependency.

Each of the six other categories is covered with concrete per-file zero-match evidence; session-notes.js correctly cleared as a pure-function decoy; cordis.patch.yml classified as composition per API-08, not a source patch, with no invented coupling.

Explicitly argues zero hits are a screening result, not compatibility: heuristic patterns, curated card set, the decisive deleted dependency invisible to the seven regexes, and remedy unverifiable statically — while separating the real apiProxy break from negatives.

Proposes build/typecheck equivalent, --dump-config composition smoke with no pending (explicitly no apiProxy/remote wait), isolated cold boot, a functional providers call, and artifact smoke — all framed as proposed, never claimed executed.
